name: Evolvable-structure library decides (live)
description: Lets the esoi library's own leaderboard decide: a rival on the same cases replaces the selected part only on a statistically significant gain, tested paired per case when per-case outcomes exist and by Fisher's exact test on the pass counts otherwise, and the repository's committed selection is read the way production reads it.
advantages: Measures the mechanism production uses, not a copy of it; a first selection is labelled a best guess; drift between the records and the committed selection is found.
disadvantages: Most cases are synthetic leaderboards, with one case on the repository's own committed selection; whether a person adopts a promotion is not covered.

name: Keep the selection as written (floor)
description: Never switches to a rival and never reads the committed selection, so the selection stays whatever someone last wrote, however the metric reads.
advantages: No cost and no library dependency; marks what the cases reward by what this floor fails.
disadvantages: Selection follows habit instead of measurement, so a better part is never adopted and a drifted selection goes unseen.
